projects.title: scale0 - Autonomous AIOps Self-Healing Platform
projects.description: Architected an autonomous GitOps pipeline orchestrating Generative AI models (Claude 3.5 Sonnet) for incident triage. Used LangGraph to gate feasibility and generate structured fix instructions, handing execution to an autonomous code-editing agent (Aider) to patch the repository and open a PR. Engineered a 3-strike self-correction loop using kubectl diff for zero-downtime state synchronization.

projects.title: TrafficWatch (Civic-Tech AI System)
projects.description: Built a real-time computer vision pipeline with YOLOv5 and OpenCV to automatically flag traffic violations from live video feeds. Integrated Tesseract OCR for automated License Plate Recognition (ALPR), passing structured data to a robust backend for validation and reviewer dashboard rendering.

projects.title: DentalAI - Generative AI Clinical Assistant
projects.description: Built a conversational agent using LangChain and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to analyze medical literature. Implemented semantic search via Vector Databases and strict data-privacy protocols to handle sensitive health records securely.

projects.title: BlueLedger - MRV & Carbon Credit Transaction System
projects.description: Designed a Measurement, Reporting, & Verification system extracting EXIF geolocation data to map vegetation sites. Estimated CO2 absorption and issued verifiable carbon credits on Polygon. Built a secure architecture with JWT-based authentication and signed blockchain transactions.

projects.title: EDUNITI – Scalable Learning Platform
projects.description: Scalable Learning Platform for High Traffic Events built with Kubernetes auto-scaling (1->8 worker replicas) and RabbitMQ submission queue handling 20,000+ exam submissions at 634 req/sec. Winner at XENIA 26.

projects.title: AI Meeting Summarizer
projects.description: Real-time AI transcription streaming via Server-Sent Events (SSE) and local LLMs for instant meeting notes and action item extraction.

projects.title: Transformer Password Security Analyzer
projects.description: Transformer neural network model trained on 10M+ breached passwords, deployed via Flask API for real-time entropy and vulnerability scoring (Barclays Hackathon).

projects.title: AI-notesGenerator (deNote)
projects.description: Multi-modal, AI-powered note generation and organization platform powered by Google Gemini API and rich text formatting.

projects.title: Dynamic AGV Scheduling System
projects.description: Intelligent pathfinding and collision avoidance system for automated guided vehicles using Python and Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm.

projects.title: Weather Trend Forecasting
projects.description: Machine learning forecasting system utilizing Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, and Random Forest models for climate trend prediction.

projects.title: Web3 Crowdfunding Platform
projects.description: Decentralized crowdfunding dApp built with Solidity smart contracts, Hardhat testing environment, and React frontend.

projects.title: Decentralized Agri-Supply Chain
projects.description: Dynamic pricing smart contracts with decentralized Oracle integration (Chainlink) for transparent agricultural supply tracking.
